Good question — it’s pretty simple 😊
They can request an exchange within 30 days of receiving the order.
They’ll start it through the returns portal using the order number and email/postcode.
They choose the item and select the exchange option. 
A couple of things to keep in mind:
Exchanges are for a different size of the same item, not a different product. 
The new item is sent once the return is scanned in at the warehouse. 
If the size is out of stock, they’ll receive a refund instead.
Exchanges are available in France, so that part is all good 👍
